items.label: Iran conflict -- continued escalation, no de-escalation; Iran to declare new restricted zone near Strait of Hormuz
items.detail: New developments since the 2026-09-06 report (live web search, Sept 6 sources): Iran/IRGC claimed on Sept 6 it attacked a US naval drone (unmanned surface vessel) attempting to enter the Strait of Hormuz, and separately struck 3 more oil tankers on an 'unauthorised route' plus 3 more vessels it called 'America-affiliated' (Malay Mail, SCMP, Euronews, ABC News, all Sept 6). Iran's top security official Mohsen Rezaei announced Iran will declare a new 'prohibited/restricted zone' outside the Strait of Hormuz in the coming days, with any vessel entering without Iranian coordination facing sanctions -- markets read this as reducing the odds of restored normal Hormuz traffic (Arab News, Al Jazeera, SBS, Sept 6). CENTCOM confirmed it has redirected 92 commercial vessels, disabled 3, and boarded 2 more to enforce its naval blockade -- a materially larger shipping-disruption figure than the 2026-09-06 report cited (Al Jazeera live updates, Sept 6). No ceasefire is in effect. Brent crude closed $96.82/bbl on Sept 6 (+0.56% d/d, +9% on the week, TradingEconomics). The account holds no direct oil & gas exposure (CCJ is a uranium miner, not oil & gas) but remains 69.54% concentrated in SPY5+SPYL, which would be hit hard by any broad equity selloff or oil-driven inflation surprise.
items.recommendation: Do not add to SPY5/SPYL or initiate new discretionary equity purchases while the Strait of Hormuz restricted-zone declaration and shipping disruption remain unresolved. Accelerate the DBC and TLT diversification actions in this report -- both would partially cushion an oil/inflation-driven equity shock -- rather than waiting for the next scheduled review.

items.label: Data-limitation disclosure -- hedge/cluster correlations carried forward from 2026-09-06, not freshly recomputed this run
items.detail: This run's background subagent tasked with recomputing the 7-hedge-candidate x 3-cluster correlation matrix did not complete within a reasonable time window (still running after an extended wait). A direct main-thread attempt to fetch and hand-parse 19 separate 1-year daily price-history payloads (12 held tickers + 7 hedge candidates) was aborted rather than risk misattributing one of 19 large, unlabeled numeric arrays to the wrong ticker -- an error there could silently put a wrong correlation number into this report. Since every position in the account is unchanged from the 2026-09-06 run (same tickers, same share counts -- confirmed via live get_account_positions), the 2026-09-06 correlation figures are carried forward this run with explicit staleness labels on every item that cites them, following the same disclosure practice used during the 2026-09-05 degraded run. hedge_analysis and diversification_actions below are dated 2026-09-06 accordingly. Separately, today (2026-09-07) is US Labor Day -- US markets are closed, so the daily_pnl figures below for US-listed names (CRWV, TTWO, FCX, CCJ, GEV, GOOG, LLY, NEM, KGC) are IBKR's carried-forward Friday 2026-09-04 session P&L, bit-for-bit identical to the 2026-09-06 report's figures, not a new trading session; only the LSE-listed legs (SPY5, SPYL, IGLN, REMX, SSLV) reflect an actual live Monday session, which was near-flat.
items.recommendation: On the next run, verify whether the stalled correlation subagent completed in the background; if so, use its output. Otherwise, retry the correlation recompute with a fresh subagent early in the run so there is time budget to complete it before finalizing the report.
